title: Engram Harness Standing-Check Goals v1
description: Registry of read-only standing checks (task O4). A goal only SELECTS an approved check by ID from docs/harness/checks/registry.json; it never carries a command, argv, shell string, environment or credential. Structure only: cross-references (check ID in the H3 registry, timeout within policy, runbook exists) are enforced by run-standing-checks.py.

policy_version.description: Policy version the registry was written under; must equal the H3 check registry policy_version.

goals.description: Standing goals. IDs are unique (enforced by the runner).

items.description: One read-only standing check with an accountable owner.

id.description: Goal identifier (also used in file names and sandbox task IDs).

check_id.description: Approved check ID that must exist in the H3 check registry and the H2 check catalog.

owner.description: Accountable owner handle named in the alert report. A handle, not a delivery channel.

schedule.description: When a scheduler may run the goal. manual goals are never run by the scheduler.

timeout_seconds.description: Total timeout of one run; must not exceed the registry timeout of the check nor the sandbox maximum.

on_failure.description: Alert-only: a failure produces a local report; there is no remediation action.

runbook.description: Repo-relative path of the document the alert points the owner to.
